sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the headwear of a busy market town of radio towers and broadcast stalls, traders and porters from many places. Four pieces, each worn by a head-and-shoulders figure, front and three-quarter view: a neatly wound market turban of one coloured cloth, no jewel, no plume; a trader's soft round cap with a short tassel; a porter's ring-shaped head-pad for carrying baskets, worn on bare hair; a woman's headscarf of printed cloth tied at the nape. Every piece sits close on the head, no taller than the head, one clear silhouette each, readable from far away. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, coral, teal, saffron and sand, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, costume party.
